main_measure.name: OLS slope of next-day excess return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 confirms (with supporting mean > 0); t <= -2 rejects; otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean next-day excess return on forecast > 0 bars above 0

decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more and the mean excess next-day return on forecast > 0 bars is above 0.
reading: Situation = raw fall_in_swings value below 0 (a down day; day-return sign if not recorded) with forecast > 0 (long); slope t is cluster-robust by UTC day (CR1, all coins' bars of a day as one cluster); the 300-bar and 200-day minimums count bars with forecast above 0 that have a next-day return inside their window; coin mean daily return is over all its windows' next-day returns.

direction_check.why: main measure +4.22e-05 on the check folds against +0.0002818 on every fold
